summary: Inter & Co filed a 6-K disclosing that indirect subsidiary Banco Inter S.A. signed a Share Purchase Agreement to buy Wiz Co's 39.75% stake in Inter Digital Corretora e Consultoria em Seguros S.A. (Inter Seguros) for R$409,487,500, CDI-indexed and payable at closing, making Banco Inter sole shareholder. Closing conditions include Central Bank of Brazil and CADE antitrust approvals; no board recommendation or advisor named. The asset serves 9 million active contracts inside the Inter Super App, offering innovation speed and value capture. Watch Brazilian regulatory timing and CDI adjustment to effective consideration.
